thread:
maria_support: Customer ACMECorp hitting p99 ~4.2s and intermittent 504s for chat.generate in us-east-1 since ~09:20 UTC. Several tickets opened.

maria_support: Recent proxy logs show batcher_hold spiking to ~2.5s for tiny payloads.

maria_support: Sample proxy line:
```
[09:21:03] req_id=abc123 path=/v1/chat.generate latency=4210ms status=504 batcher_hold_ms=2500 batch_size=1
```

sam_sre: On it. Assigning. Any config rollouts in last 24h? @liz_dev were you touching the continuous-batcher config?

deploy-bot: Deployed config redwood/continuous-batcher v2.3.7 at 2026-02-14T09:05:00Z by liz_dev

liz_dev: i pushed a change yesterday that increased coalesce_window_ms from 30 -> 80 to improve throughput for large prompts. PR: https://git.company/pr/834
liz_dev: there was supposed to be an immediate-flush path for tiny payloads but looks like the flag wasn't wired due to a key name mismatch.

sam_sre: ok likely culprit. maria, can you get a minimal repro from the customer (payload + qps)?

maria_support: customer provided sample: 3-5 character messages at ~120 rps steady bursts. curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}] }'
```

liz_dev: reproduced locally on a sim node: when qps>100 and payloads are tiny, coalesce window 80ms batches many single-token requests; jitter + tiny decode cycles cause KV cache GC-like pauses and amplify into >2s hold in the end-to-end path. The immediate-flush flag didn't take effect because config key was 'immediateFlush' in runtime but we wrote 'immediate_flush' in the rollout.

sam_sre: mitigation plan (short):
1) rollback coalesce_window_ms to 30ms on a canary subset in us-east.
2) enable immediateFlush override for routes with avg_tokens < 10.
3) add a short-term alert: batcher_hold_p50 > 100ms per-host to catch regressions.
Canary to 20% hosts, watch 10m.

liz_dev: opening hotfix PR now and will push canary. PR 842.

liz_dev: hotfix applied to canary hosts. commands used:
```
redwoodctl rollout config continuous-batcher --env us-east --hosts canary --set coalesce_window_ms=30 --set immediateFlush=true
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started for config continuous-batcher to 12 hosts (canary subset)

tim_oncall: Monitoring metrics: p99 dropped from ~4.2s -> ~1.1s on canary within 2 minutes. 504 errors on canary went to zero. :thumbsup:

maria_support: notifying customer about canary results and asking for verification on their traffic spike window.

sam_sre: follow-ups: add unit test for config key aliases, create an e2e small-payload perf test in the CI perf suite, and add runbook section describing "small-payload immediate flush" config. I'll file tickets.

sam_sre: Tickets: PERF-543 (e2e test), INFRA-789 (config alias fix), DOCS-112 (runbook)

maria_support: will keep escalations open for 30m of stable metrics then close with customer.

liz_dev: sorry about the regression, pushing a longer-term default change to avoid this class of break and adding pre-merge perf check for small-payload scenarios.
